redlist_no.citation: Artsdatabanken (2021, 24. november). Norsk rødliste for arter 2021. Utvalg https://lister.artsdatabanken.no:443/rodlisteforarter/2021?Export=true. https://lister.artsdatabanken.no/rodlisteforarter/2021
redlist_no.citation_evidence: Verbatim from the workbook's 'Siteres som' sheet (row 0, single-cell entry).
redlist_no.assessed_name_registry_evidence: Workbook 'Feltnavn og beskrivelser' sheet defines 'Vitenskapelig navn id' as 'Gyldig vitenskapelig navn id ved vurderingstidspunkt, i henhold til Artsnavnebase' — an authoritative statement that the id belongs to the Artsnavnebase name registry.
redlist_no.resolution_rule: Two-step exact bridge — (1) match the workbook's Vitenskapelig navn id against the artsnavnebase_scientific_name_id namespace (populated from NorTaxa's DwC taxonID under the declared identifier_namespace_semantics); (2) require the source row's scientificName to canonically agree with the workbook's scientific_name_snapshot. Failing either step leaves the row unresolved with taxon_id NULL and an explicit unresolved_reason. Name matching is never used as a fallback for identity.

notes: The XLSX file itself carries no license notice. Sheets present: 'Vurderinger', 'Feltnavn og beskrivelser', 'Ekspertkomitéer', 'Siteres som' — only the last carries provenance text (the citation, above).

The Artsdatabanken portal at https://artsdatabanken.no/ (parent of https://lister.artsdatabanken.no/) publishes its data-terms page separately; that page has not been fetched or archived as part of this build.

For reference: the NorTaxa 1.284 acquisition record in database/taxonomy/sources/nortaxa/1.284/request.json declares expected_license = 'CC-BY 4.0'. This is a related-dataset expectation, NOT a confirmed license for the 2021 red-list workbook.
license.required_before_publication: Fetch the Artsdatabanken terms page (e.g. https://artsdatabanken.no/dataandconditions or the equivalent Norwegian URL), record the license identifier + retrieval SHA-256, and set state='published' + publication metadata.
